changelog:
Initial release of the nofa-backtest skill.

- Provides an API for crypto trading strategy backtesting, supporting strategy creation with decision trees.
- Includes technical indicators (RSI, EMA, MA, MACD, etc.) for strategy building.
- Supports historical backtesting and simulated (dry-run) trading sessions.
- Features risk management with configurable stop loss, take profit, and position sizing.
- Registration and authentication via API key system; strong security guidance included.
- Paid premium endpoints available via x402 (XRPL payment-gated) access.
summary: Crypto trading strategy backtesting and simulated trading API for AI agents. Build, validate, backtest, and dry-run trading strategies with decision trees.
